content: At the end of the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, written in 829/1426 for Bāysunghur, Ibn Turka offers a lettrist prognostication of the duration of the Timurid state: calculating from Shāhrukh's name, he predicts its glory will persist for one century, the whole of the ninth Islamic century. Melvin-Koushki calls this a fairly accurate prediction.
